name: Purchase receipt
meaning: Goods received against a purchase order, valued from the order; offset to GR/IR clearing.

name: Purchase return
meaning: Goods returned to a supplier. Set by regime; interim seed (unverified): document value, negative receipt. For goods received against a purchase order line the document value is the GR/IR debit of the positions the return debits, the latest (ADR-0020 rule 5 note).

name: Sales issue
meaning: Goods issued for a sale, valued at the preliminary price and revalued at period end.

name: Sales return receipt
meaning: Goods a customer returned. Set by regime; interim seed (unverified): preliminary price, revalued issue: a negative issue revalued at period end, as SAP values a customer return (ADR-0020 rule 5 note, 2026-11-21). A regime may choose document value with issue return instead (ADR-0020 rule 12 note).

name: Transfer out
meaning: Issuing side of a transfer between warehouses; the receiving side is transfer_in on the same document.

name: Transfer in
meaning: Receiving side of a transfer; takes exactly the value that left.

name: Stock count shortage
meaning: Quantity missing at a stock count. Set by regime; interim seed (unverified): preliminary price, revalued issue.

name: Stock count surplus
meaning: Quantity found in excess at a stock count. Set by regime; interim seed (unverified): preliminary price, receipt.

name: Internal consumption
meaning: Goods issued for internal use.

name: Other receipt
meaning: Goods received without a purchase order, valued from the document.

name: Other issue
meaning: Goods issued for a purpose no other movement type covers.

name: Scrap
meaning: Goods destroyed or written off.

name: Opening balance
meaning: Stock taken over at migration, valued from the import (DS-21).

name: Production issue
meaning: Components issued to a production order's cost object, valued at the preliminary price and revalued at period end (ADR-0035).

name: Production return
meaning: Components returned from a production order: a negative issue at the period's preliminary price, revalued with issues (ADR-0035).

name: Production receipt
meaning: Main output received from a production order, at the preliminary price and revalued at period end (ADR-0035).

name: Co-product receipt
meaning: Co-product received from a production order, revalued at period end by coefficient (ADR-0035).

name: By-product receipt
meaning: By-product received from a production order. Set by regime; interim seed (unverified): the by_product_price list, final at once (ADR-0035).

name: Disassembly issue
meaning: Item issued to a disassembly order (ADR-0034, ADR-0035).

name: Disassembly receipt
meaning: Component received from a disassembly order, revalued at period end (ADR-0035).

name: Free goods issue
meaning: Free goods delivered with a sale under a promotion; offset as the regime chooses (ADR-0047 rule 17).

name: Quality sample
meaning: Sample units destroyed or used up by testing, issued from an inspection lot's held stock (quality_inspection or blocked) by an internal_consumption line when the usage decision is carried out (ADR-0070 rule 15); offset as internal consumption.
